description.value:
Frequency once per day (twice per day at 12th level)

Your stand does something its stats allow that none of your Stand Abilities cover: stretching, catching, inhaling, holding, copying or forcing, like Star Platinum inhaling a fog stand or plucking a tiny stand out between two fingers. The GM sets the effect with one rule: it's worth about one action of a Stand Ability of your level, such as a Strike with new reach, a skill check using the stand's stat bonus, or a basic save for @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] damage plus one minor condition. You can't repeat the same trick in the same encounter, and it can't copy another stand's ability.
